initialExam.title: FMGE June 2026
initialExam.conductingBody: National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS)
initialExam.description: Foreign Medical Graduate Examination — mandatory screening test for Indian citizens with foreign MBBS degrees to practice medicine in India.
initialExam.eligibility: MBBS degree from a foreign medical college recognized by the respective country's medical council
initialExam.syllabus: 300 MCQs covering all subjects of MBBS: Pre-clinical (Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry), Para-clinical (Pathology, Pharmacology, Microbiology, Forensic Medicine), Clinical (Medicine, Surgery, OBG, Pediatrics, Ophthalmology, ENT, Community Medicine, Dermatology, Psychiatry, Orthopaedics, Radiology, Anaesthesia).
initialExam.examPattern: Computer-based test. 300 MCQs, 2 sessions (150 each). Total duration: 5 hours 30 minutes.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Pass FMGE (minimum 150/300) → Register with State Medical Council → Practice in India
initialExam.jobRole: Registered Medical Practitioner eligible for government and private practice in India
initialExam.careerGrowth: General Practitioner → Specialist (via NEET PG) → Senior positions in government/private hospitals.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit natboard.edu.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: Enables practice in India, eligibility for government medical posts
